thread:
anya: Heads-up, seeing a bunch of GPU nodes in eu-west-1 failing to start pods — checks show keystore decrypt errors and audit events missing. This started right after the subnet tag reshuffle this morning.

devon: Can you paste the node agent logs? KMS error codes would help.

anya: Logs —
```
2026-03-20T09:13:44Z node-agent[pid=72]: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to use key
2026-03-20T09:13:44Z node-agent[pid=72]: keystore: audit write failed: no records (0 entries)
2026-03-20T09:13:45Z kubelet[pid=103]: container start backoff: failed to mount keystore
```

sre-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1-gpu-warm-pool capacity dropped from 46 -> 29 in 5m. Ticket auto-created: #INC-9821

mike: That AccessDenied smells like IAM condition on subnet tags + role binding. We applied subnet tag refactor at 07:30 — propagation to ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces/iam:PassRole sometimes lags in AWS.

lucy: If it's IAM propagation, short-term mitigation: add a temporary inline policy to the node instance role allowing kms:Decrypt on the keystore key ARN and allow s3:PutObject for audit bucket from the instance role.

anya: Trying the canary: re-apply the old tag to subnet-a and restart node-agent on one GPU node.

anya: Can confirm — after re-tag + systemctl restart node-agent, node came back in 45s, keystore decrypts ok, audit events start flowing again.

devon: Good. Plan: 1) re-tag affected subnets (canary -> all), 2) rollout a short-lived policy to instance roles as safety net, 3) check flow logs & audit retention, 4) run capacity heal script. Who owns the re-tag rollout?

mike: Ops will run re-tag rollout. I'll prepare policy patch and firewall egress rule to allow keystore proxy endpoints (keystore.internal.redwood.net:443). Note: enabling hosted keystore fallback increases egress cost — rough estimate +$0.06/node/hr while enabled.

lucy: Also request adding an audit pipeline check that surfaces missing audit records per-subnet for 24h after infra changes.

anya: Will monitor post-rollout, running probes: `kubectl -n gpu get pods --field-selector=status.phase!=Running` and `curl -sS https://keystore.internal.redwood.net/health` every 30s. I'll post results in INC-9821.

sre-bot: UPDATE: incident INC-9821 tagged sev2. Current capacity gap: 17 nodes. Estimated customer impact: degraded throughput in eu-west-1 for 2 tiered routes.

mike: Rolling re-tag now (staggered 1 subnet / 2 min). I'll post completion times.

anya: Canary completed ✅ — subnet-a re-tagged, node-agent restart success. Moving to subnet-b.

lucy: Filing PR for the audit pipeline check and retention bump. Assigning to @lucy for review.

mike: Re-tag rollout done. Reverted temporary inline policies after verifying audit entries. All GPU nodes returned to Ready over 12m.

anya: Postmortem notes: unexpected IAM condition sensitivity to subnet tag names + no automated audit alerts. Action items: update runbook, add audit check, schedule weekly keystore integration smoke tests. :thumbsup:

devon: Thanks team — good catch/fix. I'll close INC-9821 once postmortem is uploaded.
